people.name: Baruch
people.line: Jeremiah's scribe who recorded and delivered his prophecies.

people.name: Cushi
people.line: Ancestor of Jehudi, who read Jeremiah's scroll

people.name: Jehudi
people.line: An official who read Jeremiah's scroll to Jehoiakim.

people.name: Shelemiah
people.line: Grandfather of Jehudi, who read Jeremiah's scroll

translations.web: Therefore all the princes sent Jehudi the son of Nethaniah, the son of Shelemiah, the son of Cushi, to Baruch, saying, “Take in your hand the scroll in which you have read in the ears of the people, and come.” So Baruch the son of Neriah took the scroll in his hand, and came to them.
translations.bsb: Then all the officials sent word to Baruch through Jehudi son of Nethaniah, the son of Shelemiah, the son of Cushi, saying, “Bring the scroll that you read in the hearing of the people, and come here.” So Baruch son of Neriah took the scroll and went to them.

translations.asv: Therefore all the princes sent Jehudi the son of Nethaniah, the son of Shelemiah, the son of Cushi, unto Baruch, saying, Take in thy hand the roll wherein thou hast read in the ears of the people, and come.
